title: Faust documentation distinguishes Pulp reference DSPs from optional external code generation

needles: Pulp provides optional external codegen separately
Pulp reference DSPs do not depend on it

installed_sdk.rationale: These edits correct documentation provenance and optional-tool wording. They add no installed header, target, symbol, or sequencer API.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI verb, flag, handler, or document operation changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No Timeline MCP definition, handler, schema, or authority boundary changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No live product capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The design-time capability manifest is unchanged; the documentation correction publishes no sequencer capability.
